description: The Pentagon had canceled Anthropic's military contracts in March following the AI startup's refusal to remove safeguards on its Claude model. headline: Who is Thélyson Orélien, the young writer whose promising literary breakthrough abruptly unraveled?
description: The Canadian-Haitian author of the novel 'C'était ça ou mourir' ('It Was Either That Or Die') has been at the center of a media storm amid suspicions he used AI to write his book. Here is a look back at the journey of a writer with an unusual background.
